example.title: Shingled harbour warehouse with a 'Greetings from Lubec' sign

brief: A long single-storey harbour warehouse of weathered grey shingle under an orange-red metal roof, with a big painted postcard sign on its side. One photo. Older than 1970: herring smokehouses, net sheds and fish houses on stilts in these harbours are 1880-1940 buildings; no newer examples. Piles carried 10 m below the modelled bed (spec rule 4).
